…venge by just beating Elliott over the half-mile stage, but Metcalfe gained on Bowers, and Chapman went off in front of Simmonds, who had to give ground to a better man, so that Pettit had an 8 yards lead over Watts for the final quarter.…
Wright gained on Matthews over the first 220, and then Bowers all but caught Simmonds on the second 220, but a bad change-over resulted in Ayton going off about 5 yards in front of Len Marchant.
We fielded two teams in the Scratch One Mile Medley Relay. "A" Team (Jarlett, Blunden, Clay and Marchant) were 3rd, and "B" Team (Simmonds, Watts, Main and White were 5th.
It did not affect us over Whitsun as we had no matches arranged. a course to be recommended, as we could then all (including spectator Simmonds) enjoy the British Games or our little pet pot hunts.
